classes.name: ClaimRequestDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for ClaimRequest entities, providing methods to manipulate claim request data such as setting user, employee, currency, and calculating total expenses.

methods.name: getPayGradeService
methods.description: Returns an instance of PayGradeService via dependency injection container.

methods.name: setUserByUserId
methods.description: Associates a User entity with the claim request using a user ID.

methods.name: setCurrencyByCurrencyId
methods.description: Sets the currency type for the claim request using a currency ID.

methods.name: getCurrencyByCurrencyId
methods.description: Retrieves the CurrencyType entity based on a currency ID.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the claim request using an employee number.

methods.name: getTotalExpense
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total expense of the claim request.

methods.name: getSubmittedDate
methods.description: Returns the submitted date formatted as Y-m-d or null if no date is set.
